proxy_policy: Owner-declared: HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY and lowercase forms passed unchanged from the invoking shell to every command (values not recorded). No --no-warnings, NODE_NO_WARNINGS, warning disable/redirect/preload/trace. NODE_OPTIONS absent. stdout/stderr captured raw to separate files.
isolation: env -i; fresh HOME, HUD_HOME and TMPDIR (mktemp under a short /tmp root on the WSL ext4 root) per command; selected node bin first on PATH; real ~/.hud ~/.claude ~/.codex* ~/.pi untouched
order: setup (worktrees, identities, environment, capability probe, npm ci --ignore-scripts per worktree)

per_profile: full README set (limits: builds 600, npm test 1800, mjs 600, core 900, visual 600, hud-mcp 900, format 300, fixtures 300, diff 60)
MCP-ANCESTOR.benchmark: node tests/hud-mcp/benchmark.mjs, 600 s, 12 runs in manifest/mcp-benchmark-order.txt, driver blob c36817dee4cf70c27a39a86b3965f4eb6701ceb0

NODE22-PROXY.evidence_env: NODE_PROXY_EVIDENCE_DIR = new empty captures/n22/<profile>/<command>/ per command

node24-envproxy: full README set (builds 180, npm test 1200, mjs 300, core/visual/hud-mcp 600, format/fixtures 180, diff 60)
RUNZ1-KILL.evidence_env: RUNZ1_KILL_EVIDENCE_DIR = new empty captures/rk/<profile>/<command>/ per command

reruns: Each command once. Only a README-listed known flake may get one isolated suite rerun, both logs kept.
